name: multigroupposter
description: Write a post with ChatGPT and publish it to your own Facebook groups through the MultiGroupPoster Chrome extension, as a draft or after your OK.

interface.longDescription:
MultiGroupPoster is a Chrome extension that posts to the Facebook groups you are a member of, from your own browser. This plugin lets ChatGPT do the writing and the setup for you.

Ask in plain words, for example "Write a post about my open house on Saturday and send it to my real estate groups." ChatGPT shows your saved group lists, writes the text, adds your photos or video (through a small card in the chat or an upload link), and creates the post in MultiGroupPoster.

You stay in control:
- Posts are saved as drafts by default. You check them in MultiGroupPoster and press Publish.
- Publishing straight from the chat needs a summary and your clear yes first.
- The posting is done by the extension in your own Chrome, with your own Facebook session, to groups you saved yourself. ChatGPT never gets your Facebook password.
- ChatGPT follows each post and gives you the links, group by group, and explains any group that failed.

What you need: the MultiGroupPoster extension in Chrome, signed in, with at least one group list. To connect, open Help, Connect an AI assistant, and follow the two steps. Want to look first? Choose "Try a demo account" on the sign-in page: sample lists, nothing is posted.
defaultPrompt: Show me my MultiGroupPoster group lists.
Write a post for my local buy and sell groups and save it as a draft.
Did my last post go out? Give me the links.

positive.prompt: Show me my MultiGroupPoster group lists.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved group lists with the number of groups in each.

positive.description: Write a post and save it as a draft
positive.prompt: Write a short post about a weekend bakery special and save it as a draft for my local buy and sell groups.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes the text, calls create_post in draft mode for the matching list, and get_post_status shows draft ready.

positive.description: Open the post card to add photos
positive.prompt: Open the post card so I can add photos to a bike sale post.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the MultiGroupPoster post card in the chat with the person's group lists and a place to add photos.

positive.description: Publish now after a clear yes
positive.prompt: Publish 'Open house Saturday 10 to 2' to my real estate groups now.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a summary (text, list, number of groups) and asks first. After the person says yes, calls create_post with confirmed true; get_post_status goes from posting to done with a result per group (demo account: simulated, nothing reaches Facebook).

positive.description: Check where the last post went out
positive.prompt: Did my last post go out? Give me the links.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest post and lists each group with its status and post link.

negative.description: Groups the person did not save
negative.prompt: Post this to all Facebook groups in my city.
Publish my bakery post now, don't show me anything.
Post it again, the first try failed.
